reason: In src/sentry/spans/consumers/process/flusher.py:53,105, flusher processes are created via multiprocessing.get_context('spawn').Process (SpawnProcess), which is a sibling of multiprocessing.context.Process under BaseProcess, so isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) in join() at flusher.py:346-347 is always False and process.terminate() is never called. However, this isinstance check in join() was pre-existing before the patch (previously isinstance(self.process, multiprocessing.Process)).
